title: DLF sells penthouse for Rs 271 cr in luxury housing project in Gurugram

The penthouse sale achieved Rs 1.58 lakh per square foot on super area. DLF expects over Rs 40,000 crore revenue from this project. Demand for luxury apartments has increased significantly across major cities post-COVID.

title: French lender's India treasurer pegs rupee floor near 'fair value' of 96 per dollar
description: The Indian rupee is poised for stability against the dollar throughout this financial year. Initiatives to entice dollar investments and a decline in commodity prices are expected to mitigate risks. With foreign investors returning to Indian equity and debt markets, actions from the central bank should help minimize significant currency fluctuations in the short term. Additionally, Indian bonds could stabilize at a yield of approximately 6.70%.

title: India bonds tread water ahead of US, local inflation prints
description: On Monday, Indian government bonds remained stable following last week's increases. The rise in oil prices countered some support from softer economic data from the United States. Traders are eagerly awaiting inflation reports from both India and the U.S., which will significantly influence bond market trends this week. Notably, ultra-long bonds saw a rise, likely driven by value purchases from insurers.

title: Indel Money readies its biggest ever public sale of debt: Bankers
description: Indel Money is set to pursue a remarkable fundraising initiative of up to five billion rupees within this month. This forthcoming public debt offering marks the company's most significant endeavor to date. The bonds will have maturities ranging from 400 days to six years, boasting attractive coupon rates between nine and eleven point five percent. Rated A- by India Ratings, these bonds are expected to close on August thirty-first.

description: Indian benchmark indices ended largely flat on Monday as rising crude prices and Middle East uncertainty offset optimism from softer US jobs data. title: Indian bonds steady as soft US data offsets oil rise
